title: test
description: Stage output contract: tests run. Whether the tests are meaningful is REVIEW's required output, not this stage's (#541).

failures.description: ids of failing tests (empty when green)

validation_notes.description: what the tests assert / any gaps

change_class.description: #41: deterministic change classification from the git diff (base_sha..worktree). Set ONLY by the ENGINE-lane runner — a model claim here is ignored at the context fold. 'docs-only' relaxes downstream test-coverage criteria and short-circuits this stage to an honest skip.

skipped.description: #41: reason this stage was short-circuited without running the suite (e.g. 'docs-only'). Present only on a skip; never a faked green run — 'passed' means 'nothing to fail'.

test_scope.description: #558: whether the unit suite ran only the tests the project adapter mapped from the diff ('impacted') or the whole suite ('full'). Set ONLY by the ENGINE-lane runner — a model claim here is ignored at the context fold. An 'impacted' green is a green on a SUBSET, not a full green.

tests_selected.description: #558: number of test files the impacted run selected (0 for a full run). Set only by the ENGINE-lane runner.

failure_kinds.description: #541: the kinds of the failures in a red run. Only ['infra'] means no test reached a verdict (the run timed out or could not start), so the engine retries TEST instead of sending it back to IMPLEMENT. Set only by the ENGINE-lane runner.

test_scope_reason.description: #558: why this scope was chosen (e.g. the fallback that forced a full run). Set only by the ENGINE-lane runner.
